items.title: Your Android device could soon become your PC’s second screen via Link to Windows
items.summary:
Credit: Tushar Mehta / Android Authority 

TL;DR 

Strings of code in the Link to Windows app reveal a second screen experience called “Extend display.” 
 This feature would turn your Android phone or tablet into a second screen for your PC. 
 The experience will stop if your PC locks, the connection is lost, or if the phone’s display receiver fails. 

When you’ve grown accustomed to a dual-screen setup, it’s hard to go back to using a single screen. If you don’t have an extra monitor handy, you could turn your old tablet into a second screen with spacedesk . Samsung also offers a Second Screen feature on select Galaxy tablets. However, if you want a more convenient option than these, Microsoft is building a solution.

The folks over at Windows Latest have spotted new strings of code in the Link to Windows app. These strings of code reference a feature called “Extend display.” Aptly named, this feature would allow you to extend your PC’s screen to your Android phone or tablet.
items.t: Your Android device could soon become your PC’s second screen via Link to Windows

items.title: Google gains US smartphone market ground as Samsung and Motorola slip
items.summary:
TL;DR 

Google’s Pixel 11 series helped double its US smartphone shipment market share from 3% in Q2 2026 to 6% in Q3 2026. 
 Despite the quarterly growth, Google’s market share remains below the 7% it held in Q3 2025, while Samsung and Motorola also lost ground quarter-over-quarter. 
 Apple dominated the US market with a 57% shipment share, even as overall smartphone shipments declined 9% year-over-year. 

The Pixel 11 series has proven to be a much-needed boost for Google’s US smartphone market share, essentially doubling the company’s shipments from 3% in Q2 2026 to 6% in Q3 2026. That win, however, appears to have come at the expense of competitors like Samsung and Motorola , with Google still struggling to match its performance from the same period last year.

The new information comes via Counterpoint Research’s latest data , which highlights how the US smartphone market performed in Q3 2026. For reference, the Pixel 11 series came out in August, so it makes sense that Google experienced a meaningful boost, going from 3% shipment market share to 6% quarter-over-quarter.
items.t: Google gains US smartphone market ground as Samsung and Motorola slip

items.title: The OSTA O1 Pro is the latest slab phone to join the wide-screen trend
items.summary:
TL;DR 

HUAWEI sub-brand OSTA has launched the O1 Pro smartphone, featuring a wide display with a unique 16:9.5 aspect ratio. 
 The smartphone features similar internal hardware to the HUAWEI Pura X View, which launched in China a couple of months ago. 
 This could mark the beginning of a new trend, with a handful of other Chinese brands also expected to launch a wide-screen slab phone. 

Wide-screen slab phones are gradually emerging as a new form factor, combining the cover screen width of a wide foldable with a traditional slab-type smartphone. HUAWEI threw its hat in the ring with the Pura X View in September , and now, its sub-brand OSTA has joined that list with its debut phone.

The OSTA O1 Pro packs a 6.39-inch, 120Hz OLED screen with a 16:9.5 aspect ratio, identical to the Pura X View. It’s only 6.68mm thick and weighs approximately 200 grams, according to the O1 Pro product page .

items.title: Signal is blocking screenshots to prevent Gemini and Siri AI from scanning your chats
items.summary:
TL;DR 

Signal is introducing protections to prevent Gemini and Siri AI from scanning private conversations on Android and iOS 27. 
 The protections also block users from taking screenshots inside Signal, but they can be disabled. 
 Signal is calling on Google, Apple, and Microsoft to give app developers better tools to restrict AI access without compromising app functionality. 

AI assistants are increasingly doing things on our phones that would previously require us to open an app ourselves. Gemini can already order food and book rides using third-party Android apps , and just yesterday, Google started rolling out similar computer-use capabilities on Macs . Meanwhile, Apple’s Siri AI can understand what’s on your iPhone’s screen. But what happens when the app an AI assistant tries to read contains information that was never meant to leave it?

That’s a question Signal is tackling head-on. The encrypted messaging service announced today that it is introducing protections against AI assistants capturing its content on Android and iOS 27.
items.t: Signal is blocking screenshots to prevent Gemini and Siri AI from scanning your chats

items.title: One UI 9.5 code hints Samsung will push its own updates to its Android laptops
items.summary:
Credit: Mishaal Rahman / Android Authority 

TL;DR 

Code in One UI 9.5 Beta 1 shows Samsung’s Setup Wizard on its upcoming Android laptops will ask you to agree to automatic software updates from Samsung. 
 Samsung’s Software update and Device Care apps also have laptop versions, with RAM Plus virtual memory and McAfee scans, but no Maintenance mode. 
 On Googlebooks from other brands, Google rolls out software updates itself, so Samsung’s approach could mean its laptops won’t follow the standard Googlebook update model. 

Samsung’s upcoming Android laptops aren’t just shaping up to work like a Galaxy phone with a keyboard, but they could also get updated like one. We’ve already covered the laptops codenamed Origin , their dedicated One UI interface with Circle to Search , how they’ll plug into the Galaxy ecosystem , the on-device Galaxy AI features for their Snapdragon X Elite chip , and features like Camera continuity, texting, and app streaming from your phone . Digging further into the One UI 9.5 Beta 1 on my Galaxy S26 Ultra, I found that Samsung is also building its own software update and device maintenance apps into these laptops.

APK teardown: This reporting is based on work-in-progress code. These features may not ship.

How Samsung will update its upcoming Android laptops is notable because on Googlebooks from other brands, Google rolls out Googlebook OS updates itself , not the laptop maker, and promises up to 10 years of updates .
items.t: One UI 9.5 code hints Samsung will push its own updates to its Android laptops
